name: Vizianagaram

sources.title: A.P. Cabinet clears district reorganisation, mandal realignment - The Hindu
List of ULBs and UDAs covered under PMAY-U 2.0 (MoHUA, Government of India)

notes: Vizianagaram was left unchanged by the December 2025 reorganisation (The Hindu), so the official division-wise list (3 divisions, 27 mandals) is current. The official 'Divisions and Mandals' table has typos: 'MERAKAMUDIAM' and 'REGIDLAMANDALAVALASA'. The spellings 'Merakamudidam' (from the official mandal-wise villages page) and 'Regidi Amadalavalasa' (the standard form of the name) are used instead; that villages page itself shows the truncated 'Regidiamadalavalas'. ULBs are taken from the MoHUA PMAY-U 2.0 ULB list. The district demography page still shows Census 2011 counts (2 municipalities, 2 nagar panchayats) from before Parvathipuram and Salur moved to Parvathipuram Manyam, so it was not used for ULBs. Rajam is listed as a municipality in PMAY-U 2.0; older DTCP lists show it as a nagar panchayat.
